294:   static open(options: ServiceOptions = {}): MasterMcpService {
295:     return new MasterMcpService(options);
296:   }
297: 
298:   get databasePath(): string {
299:     return this.dbPath;
300:   }
301: 
302:   get schemaVersion(): number {
303:     return schemaVersion(this.store.raw());
304:   }
305: 
306:   close(): void {
307:     if (this.closed) return;
308:     this.closed = true;
309:     this.store.close();
310:   }
311: 
312:   // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
313:   // master_context
314:   // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
315: 
316:   async context(input: MasterContextInput): Promise<MasterContextResult> {
317:     const task = requireText(input.task, 'task', 'Pass the coding task as a sentence, e.g. "Fix the ownership check in the offer UI".');
318:     const mode = parseMode(input.mode);
319:     const allowCreate = mode !== 'read_only';
320:     const repositoryPath = input.repositoryPath ?? null;
321: 
322:     // Config is read before discovery so `context.recent_commits` bounds the
323:     // git log we ask for (discovery re-reads it once it knows the git root).
324:     const probeConfig = loadProjectConfig(repositoryPath ?? this.cwd).config;
325: 
326:     const discovery = await discoverProject({
327:       store: this.store,
328:       clock: this.clock,
329:       project: input.project ?? null,
330:       repositoryPath,
331:       cwd: this.cwd,
332:       allowCreate,
333:       observe: { recentCommits: probeConfig.context.recentCommits },
334:       refresh: input.refresh ?? false,
335:     });
336: 
337:     const now = isoNow(this.clock);
338:     const repository = discovery.repository;
339:     const observation = discovery.observation;
340: 
341:     // Conflict detection compares the repository to the last observation, so
342:     // read the previous values before recording the new ones.
343:     const previousHead = repository?.lastHead ?? null;
344:     const previousBranch = repository?.lastBranch ?? null;
345: 
346:     let headRelation: 'same' | 'advanced' | 'diverged' | 'unknown' = 'unknown';
347:     let commitsSincePrevious: number | null = null;
348:     if (previousHead && observation?.head && observation.root) {
349:       if (previousHead === observation.head) headRelation = 'same';
350:       else {
351:         const ancestor = await isAncestor(observation.root, previousHead, observation.head);
352:         if (ancestor === true) {
353:           headRelation = 'advanced';
354:           commitsSincePrevious = await countCommitsBetween(observation.root, previousHead, observation.head);
355:         } else if (ancestor === false) headRelation = 'diverged';
356:       }
357:     }
358: 
359:     const items = this.store.loadMemoryItems(discovery.project.id);
360:     const knownSubsystems = this.store.knownSubsystems(discovery.project.id);
361: 
362:     const interpretation = interpretTask({
363:       task,
364:       project: discovery.project,
365:       config: discovery.config,
366:       knownSubsystems,
367:       affectedFiles: dedupe(input.affectedFiles),
368:       recentlyChangedFiles: observation?.recentlyChangedFiles ?? [],
369:       mode,
370:     });
371: 
372:     const fullTextScores = this.fullTextScores(
373:       discovery.project.id,
374:       [task, ...dedupe(input.affectedFiles)].join(' '),
375:     );
376:     if (fullTextScores.size === 0) {
377:       // Fall back to the interpretation's own terms so an unusual wording still
378:       // gets the ranking benefit of full-text overlap.
379:       const fallback = this.fullTextScores(discovery.project.id, interpretation.terms.join(' '));
380:       for (const [id, score] of fallback) fullTextScores.set(id, score);
381:     }
382: 
383:     const taskRecord = allowCreate
384:       ? this.upsertTaskForContext({
385:           project: discovery.project,
386:           interpretation,
387:           taskText: task,
388:           observation,
389:           now,
390:         })
391:       : this.findTaskForContext(discovery.project, task);
392: 
393:     const openTasks = this.store.listTasks(discovery.project.id, { limit: 200 });
394: 
395:     const brief = assembleBrief({
396:       project: discovery.project,
397:       repository,
398:       observation,
399:       config: discovery.config,
400:       items,
401:       fullTextScores,
402:       interpretation,
403:       task: taskRecord,
404:       openTasks,
405:       clock: this.clock,
406:       previousHead,
407:       previousBranch,
408:       headRelation,
409:       commitsSincePrevious,
410:       discoverySource: discovery.source,
411:       registeredNow: discovery.createdProject,
412:       warnings: discovery.warnings,
413:     });
414: 
415:     const maxTokens = Math.min(
416:       discovery.config.context.maxBriefTokens,
417:       mode === 'deep' ? 4000 : 2000,
418:     );
419:     const text = renderBrief(brief, { maxTokens });
420: 
421:     if (allowCreate) {
422:       if (repository && observation) {
423:         this.store.recordRepositoryObservation(repository.id, {
424:           branch: observation.branch,
425:           head: observation.head,
426:           dirty: observation.dirty,
427:           remoteUrl: observation.remoteUrl,
428:           name: observation.name,
429:           seenAt: now,
430:         });
431:       }
432:       // Project identity is refreshed from config on every pass; the brief itself
433:       // is where new engineering facts get recorded.
434:       const projectPatch: { goal?: string; phase?: string; now: string } = { now };
435:       if (!discovery.project.goal && discovery.config.goal) projectPatch.goal = discovery.config.goal;
436:       if (!discovery.project.phase && discovery.config.phase) projectPatch.phase = discovery.config.phase;
437:       if (projectPatch.goal || projectPatch.phase) {
438:         this.store.updateProject(discovery.project.id, projectPatch);
439:       }
440:       this.store.touchProject(discovery.project.id, now);
441:       this.store.recordActivity({
442:         projectId: discovery.project.id,
443:         kind: 'context',
444:         summary: `context: ${truncate(task, 120)}`,
445:         payload: {
446:           taskId: taskRecord?.id ?? null,
447:           mode: interpretation.mode,
448:           memoryConsidered: items.length,
449:           memorySelected: brief.stats.memorySelected,
450:           head: observation?.head ?? null,
451:         },
452:         source: 'master_context',
453:         now,
454:       });
455:     }
456: 
457:     return {
458:       text,
459:       brief,
460:       taskId: taskRecord?.id ?? null,
461:       projectSlug: discovery.project.slug,
462:     };
463:   }
464: 
465:   /** Full-text score overlay for ranking. Keys are record ids. */
466:   private fullTextScores(projectId: string, query: string): Map<string, number> {
467:     const scores = new Map<string, number>();
468:     if (keywords(query).length === 0) return scores;
469:     for (const hit of this.store.searchMemory({ query, projectId, limit: 80 })) {
470:       scores.set(hit.id, hit.score ?? 0);
471:     }
472:     return scores;
473:   }
474: 
475:   /** Read-only task lookup used by `mode=read_only`. */
476:   private findTaskForContext(project: Project, taskText: string): Task | null {
477:     const tasks = this.store.listTasks(project.id, { limit: 200 });
478:     return matchTask(tasks, taskText)?.task ?? null;
479:   }
480: 
481:   /**
482:    * Match the task string to a stored task, creating one when nothing matches.
483:    *
484:    * Creating a task here is not speculation: the agent stated the task, and the
485:    * record exists so that `master_complete` can attach evidence to it.
486:    */
487:   private upsertTaskForContext(input: {
488:     project: Project;
489:     interpretation: TaskInterpretation;
490:     taskText: string;
491:     observation: RepositoryObservation | null;
492:     now: string;
493:   }): Task | null {
494:     const { project, interpretation, taskText, observation, now } = input;
495:     const tasks = this.store.listTasks(project.id, { limit: 200 });
496:     const match = matchTask(tasks, taskText);
497:     const declaredFiles = interpretation.affectedFiles;
498: 
499:     if (match) {
500:       const task = match.task;
501:       const patch: Parameters<Store['updateTask']>[1] = { now };
502:       if (task.status === 'todo') patch.status = 'in_progress';
503:       if (!task.subsystem && interpretation.subsystems[0]) patch.subsystem = interpretation.subsystems[0];
504:       if (declaredFiles.length > 0) {
505:         patch.affectedFiles = dedupe([...task.affectedFiles, ...declaredFiles]);
506:       }
507:       if (observation?.branch) patch.branch = observation.branch;
508:       if (observation?.head) patch.head = observation.head;
509:       return this.store.updateTask(task.id, patch);
510:     }
511: 
512:     const title = truncate(taskText, 200);
513:     return this.store.createTask({
514:       projectId: project.id,
515:       title,
516:       description: interpretation.likelyComponents.length > 0
517:         ? `Inferred components: ${interpretation.likelyComponents.join(', ')}`
518:         : null,
519:       priority: inferPriority(taskText),
520:       status: 'in_progress',
521:       subsystem: interpretation.subsystems[0] ?? null,
522:       affectedFiles: declaredFiles,
523:       source: 'master_context',
524:       head: observation?.head ?? null,
525:       branch: observation?.branch ?? null,
526:       now,
527:     });
528:   }
529: 
530:   // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
531:   // master_complete
532:   // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
533: 
534:   async complete(input: MasterCompleteInput): Promise<MasterCompleteResult> {
535:     const summary = requireText(input.summary, 'summary', 'Summarise what was done in one sentence.');
536:     const notes: string[] = [];
537: 
538:     const discovery = await discoverProject({
539:       store: this.store,
540:       clock: this.clock,
541:       project: input.project ?? null,
542:       repositoryPath: input.repositoryPath ?? null,
543:       cwd: this.cwd,
544:       allowCreate: true,
545:       observe: { recentCommits: 1 },
546:     });
547:     const now = isoNow(this.clock);
548:     const observation = discovery.observation;
549: 
550:     const task = this.resolveTaskForCompletion({
551:       project: discovery.project,
552:       taskId: input.taskId ?? null,
553:       taskTitle: input.task ?? null,
554:       summary,
555:       observation,
556:       now,
557:       notes,
558:     });
559: 
560:     const filesChanged = dedupe(input.filesChanged);
561:     const commits = dedupe(input.commits);
562:     const blockers = dedupe(input.blockers);
563:     const unresolved = dedupe(input.unresolved);
564: 
565:     const claims = normalizeClaims(input.testsRun ?? [], input.verification ?? []);
566:     const classification = classifyVerification({ claims, results: dedupe(input.results) });
567:     notes.push(...classification.notes);
568: 
569:     const requestedStatus = parseTaskStatus(input.status) ?? null;
570:     if (input.status && !requestedStatus) {
571:       notes.push(`Ignored unknown status "${input.status}".`);
572:     }
573:     const decision = decideTaskStatus({
574:       current: task.status,
575:       verification: classification.status,
576:       blockers,
577:       requested: requestedStatus,
578:       filesChanged: filesChanged.length,
579:     });
580:     notes.push(...decision.notes);
581: 
582:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
583:     // Verifications
584:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
585:     const verificationIds: string[] = [];
586:     for (const claim of classification.accepted) {
587:       const verification = this.store.createVerification({
588:         projectId: discovery.project.id,
589:         taskId: task.id,
590:         method: claim.method,
591:         command: claim.command,
592:         result: claim.result,
593:         evidence: claim.evidence,
594:         now,
595:       });
596:       verificationIds.push(verification.id);
597:     }
598: 
599:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
600:     // Findings from discoveries
601:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
602:     const findingIds: string[] = [];
603:     const resolvedSubsystem = task.subsystem ?? null;
604:     for (const discoveryItem of input.discoveries ?? []) {
605:       const parsed = normalizeDiscovery(discoveryItem);
606:       if (!parsed) continue;
607:       const existing = this.findFindingByStatement(discovery.project.id, parsed.statement);
608:       const files = parsed.files.length > 0 ? parsed.files : [];
609:       const symbols = parsed.symbols;
610:       const guard = guardConfidence({
611:         requested: parsed.confidence,
612:         evidence: parsed.evidence,
613:         files,
614:         symbols,
615:       });
616:       if (guard.downgradedFrom) {
617:         notes.push(`Finding "${truncate(parsed.statement, 60)}": ${guard.reason}`);
618:       }
619:       if (existing) {
620:         // Same statement: strengthen rather than duplicate.
621:         const strengthened = guard.confidence;
622:         const mergedEvidence = dedupe([...existing.evidence, ...parsed.evidence]);
623:         const keepExisting =
624:           isConfidenceAtLeast(existing.confidence, strengthened) || existing.evidence.length >= parsed.evidence.length;
625:         const updated = this.store.updateFinding(existing.id, {
626:           confidence: keepExisting ? existing.confidence : strengthened,
627:           evidence: mergedEvidence,
628:           files: dedupe([...existing.files, ...files]),
629:           symbols: dedupe([...existing.symbols, ...symbols]),
630:           now,
631:         });
632:         findingIds.push(updated.id);
633:         notes.push(`Finding ${updated.id} already existed; merged evidence instead of duplicating it.`);
634:         continue;
635:       }
636:       const finding = this.store.createFinding({
637:         projectId: discovery.project.id,
638:         statement: parsed.statement,
639:         evidence: parsed.evidence,
640:         confidence: guard.confidence,
641:         subsystem: parsed.subsystem ?? resolvedSubsystem,
642:         files,
643:         symbols,
644:         source: 'master_complete',
645:         now,
646:       });
647:       findingIds.push(finding.id);
648:     }
649: 
650:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
651:     // Bugs
652:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
653:     const bugsCreated: string[] = [];
654:     for (const bugInput of input.bugsFound ?? []) {
655:       const parsed = normalizeBug(bugInput);
656:       if (!parsed) continue;
657:       const existing = this.store.findBugByTitle(discovery.project.id, parsed.title);
658:       if (existing) {
659:         notes.push(`Bug "${truncate(parsed.title, 60)}" already exists (${existing.id}); not duplicated.`);
660:         continue;
661:       }
662:       const bug = this.store.createBug({
663:         projectId: discovery.project.id,
664:         title: parsed.title,
665:         severity: parsed.severity,
666:         status: 'open',
667:         subsystem: parsed.subsystem ?? resolvedSubsystem,
668:         reproduction: parsed.reproduction,
669:         expected: parsed.expected,
670:         observed: parsed.observed,
671:         evidence: parsed.evidence,
672:         files: parsed.files,
673:         now,
674:       });
675:       bugsCreated.push(bug.id);
676:     }
677: 
678:     const bugsUpdated: string[] = [];
679:     for (const reference of dedupe(input.bugsResolved)) {
680:       const bug =
681:         this.store.getBug(reference) ?? this.store.findBugByTitle(discovery.project.id, reference) ?? null;
682:       if (!bug) {
683:         notes.push(`Could not resolve bug "${truncate(reference, 60)}"; nothing was recorded for it.`);
684:         continue;
685:       }
686:       const verified = classification.status === 'verified';
687:       const status = verified ? 'fixed_verified' : 'fix_claimed';
688:       const updated = this.store.updateBug(bug.id, {
689:         status,
690:         resolvedAt: verified ? now : null,
691:         now,
692:       });
693:       bugsUpdated.push(updated.id);
694:       if (!verified) {
695:         notes.push(
696:           `Bug ${updated.id} marked fix_claimed, not fixed_verified: no passing command or evidence was provided.`,
697:         );
698:       }
699:     }
700: 
701:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
702:     // Follow-up tasks
703:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
704:     const followUps: string[] = [];
705:     const followUpLabels: string[] = [];
706:     for (const followUpInput of input.followUp ?? []) {
707:       const parsed = normalizeFollowUp(followUpInput);
708:       if (!parsed) continue;
709:       const existingOpen = this.store
710:         .listTasks(discovery.project.id, { limit: 200 })
711:         .find((candidate) => needsWork(candidate) && sameReference(candidate.title, parsed.title));
712:       if (existingOpen) {
713:         notes.push(`Follow-up "${truncate(parsed.title, 60)}" already exists as ${existingOpen.id}.`);
714:         continue;
715:       }
716:       const followUp = this.store.createTask({
717:         projectId: discovery.project.id,
718:         title: truncate(parsed.title, 200),
719:         description: parsed.description,
720:         priority: parsed.priority,
721:         status: 'todo',
722:         subsystem: parsed.subsystem ?? resolvedSubsystem,
723:         dependencies: [task.id],
724:         source: 'master_complete',
725:         now,
726:       });
727:       followUps.push(followUp.id);
728:       followUpLabels.push(`${truncate(parsed.title, 120)} (${followUp.id})`);
729:     }
730: 
731:     // Unresolved items that are not blockers still deserve a task so they are
732:     // not lost; they are recorded as follow-ups with the same dependency.
733:     for (const item of unresolved) {
734:       const existingOpen = this.store
735:         .listTasks(discovery.project.id, { limit: 200 })
736:         .find((candidate) => needsWork(candidate) && sameReference(candidate.title, item));
737:       if (existingOpen) continue;
738:       const followUp = this.store.createTask({
739:         projectId: discovery.project.id,
740:         title: truncate(item, 200),
741:         description: `Unresolved after ${task.id}: ${truncate(summary, 160)}`,
742:         priority: 'P3',
743:         status: 'todo',
744:         subsystem: resolvedSubsystem,
745:         dependencies: [task.id],
746:         source: 'master_complete',
747:         now,
748:       });
749:       followUps.push(followUp.id);
750:       followUpLabels.push(`${truncate(item, 120)} (${followUp.id})`);
751:     }
752: 
753:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
754:     // Task + handoff
755:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
756:     const updatedTask = this.store.updateTask(task.id, {
757:       status: decision.status,
758:       verificationStatus: classification.status,
759:       affectedFiles: dedupe([...task.affectedFiles, ...filesChanged]),
760:       blockers,
761:       completedAt: decision.status === 'verified_done' ? now : null,
762:       head: observation?.head ?? task.head,
763:       branch: observation?.branch ?? task.branch,
764:       now,
765:     });
766: 
767:     const handoff = this.store.createHandoff({
768:       projectId: discovery.project.id,
769:       taskId: updatedTask.id,
770:       summary: truncate(summary, 400),
771:       workAttempted: task.title,
772:       workCompleted: decision.status === 'blocked' ? null : truncate(summary, 400),
773:       failures: claims.filter((claim) => claim.result === 'fail').map((claim) => claim.command ?? claim.method),
774:       discoveries: findingIds,
775:       blockers,
776:       unresolved,
777:       followUp: followUpLabels,
778:       subsystem: updatedTask.subsystem,
779:       branch: observation?.branch ?? null,
780:       head: observation?.head ?? null,
781:       now,
782:     });
783: 
784:     if (commits.length > 0) {
785:       notes.push(`Commits recorded: ${commits.slice(0, 5).join(', ')}.`);
786:     }
787:     if (filesChanged.length === 0 && decision.status === 'implementation_done') {
788:       notes.push('No changed files were reported; if work did land, pass files_changed so the next brief can use it.');
789:     }
790:     if (discovery.createdProject) {
791:       notes.push(`Registered new project "${discovery.project.slug}" from ${discovery.repositoryPath}.`);
792:     }
793: 
794:     this.store.touchProject(discovery.project.id, now);
795:     this.store.recordActivity({
796:       projectId: discovery.project.id,
797:       kind: 'complete',
798:       summary: `complete: ${truncate(updatedTask.title, 100)} → ${decision.status}`,
799:       payload: {
800:         taskId: updatedTask.id,
801:         handoffId: handoff.id,
802:         verification: classification.status,
803:         findings: findingIds.length,
804:         bugsCreated: bugsCreated.length,
805:       },
806:       source: 'master_complete',
807:       now,
808:     });
809: 
810:     const result: MasterCompleteResult = {
811:       text: renderCompletion({
812:         task: updatedTask,
813:         verificationStatus: classification.status,
814:         handoff,
815:       }),
816:       taskId: updatedTask.id,
817:       taskStatus: updatedTask.status,
818:       verificationStatus: classification.status,
819:       handoffId: handoff.id,
820:       recorded: {
821:         verifications: verificationIds,
822:         findings: findingIds,
823:         bugsCreated,
824:         bugsUpdated,
825:         followUps,
826:         decisions: [],
827:       },
828:       notes,
829:       projectSlug: discovery.project.slug,
830:     };
831:     return result;
832:   }
833: 
834:   /** Resolve (or create) the task a completion belongs to. */
835:   private resolveTaskForCompletion(input: {
836:     project: Project;
837:     taskId: string | null;
838:     taskTitle: string | null;
839:     summary: string;
840:     observation: RepositoryObservation | null;
841:     now: string;
842:     notes: string[];
843:   }): Task {
844:     const { project, taskId, taskTitle, summary, observation, now, notes } = input;
845: 
846:     if (taskId) {
847:       const byId = this.store.getTask(taskId.trim());
848:       if (byId && byId.projectId === project.id) return byId;
849:       const byTitle = byId ? null : this.store.findTaskByTitle(project.id, taskId.trim());
850:       if (byTitle) {
851:         notes.push(`No task id matched "${taskId}"; resolved it by exact title to ${byTitle.id}.`);
852:         return byTitle;
853:       }
854:       throw notFoundError(
855:         `No task "${taskId}" exists in project "${project.slug}".`,
856:         'Call master_context first, or pass the task title instead of an id.',
857:       );
858:     }
859: 
860:     if (taskTitle) {
861:       const tasks = this.store.listTasks(project.id, { limit: 200 });
862:       const match = matchTask(tasks, taskTitle);
863:       if (match) {
864:         if (!match.exact) {
865:           notes.push(`Matched task "${match.task.title}" (${match.task.id}) for the supplied title.`);
866:         }
867:         return match.task;
868:       }
869:       notes.push(`No stored task matched "${truncate(taskTitle, 60)}"; created a new one.`);
870:       return this.store.createTask({
871:         projectId: project.id,
872:         title: truncate(taskTitle, 200),
873:         status: 'in_progress',
874:         priority: inferPriority(taskTitle),
875:         source: 'master_complete',
876:         head: observation?.head ?? null,
877:         branch: observation?.branch ?? null,
878:         now,
879:       });
880:     }
881: 
882:     const tasks = this.store.listTasks(project.id, { limit: 200 });
883:     const openWork = tasks.filter((task) => task.status === 'in_progress' || task.status === 'blocked');
884:     if (openWork.length === 1) {
885:       notes.push(`No task supplied; attached the completion to the only in-progress task (${openWork[0]!.id}).`);
886:       return openWork[0]!;
887:     }
888:     notes.push('No task supplied; created a task from the summary.');
889:     return this.store.createTask({
890:       projectId: project.id,
891:       title: truncate(summary, 200),
892:       status: 'in_progress',
893:       source: 'master_complete',
894:       head: observation?.head ?? null,
895:       branch: observation?.branch ?? null,
896:       now,
897:     });
898:   }
899: 
900:   private findFindingByStatement(projectId: string, statement: string): Finding | null {
901:     const needle = statement.trim().toLowerCase();
902:     return (
903:       this.store
904:         .listFindings(projectId, { limit: 400 })
905:         .find((finding) => finding.statement.trim().toLowerCase() === needle) ?? null
906:     );
907:   }
908: 
909:   // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
910:   // master_search
911:   // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
912: 
913:   search(input: MasterSearchInput): MasterSearchResult {
914:     const query = requireText(input.query, 'query', 'Pass the historical detail you are looking for.');
915:     const project = input.project ? this.resolveProjectReference(input.project) : this.resolveProjectFromCwd();
916:     const kinds = (input.kinds ?? [])
917:       .map((kind) => kind.trim().toLowerCase())
918:       .filter((kind): kind is MemoryItem['kind'] => MEMORY_KIND_VALUES.includes(kind as MemoryItem['kind']));
919:     const limit = Math.min(Math.max(input.limit ?? 10, 1), 50);
920: 
921:     const hits = this.store.searchMemory({
922:       query,

984:       else if (error instanceof Error) warnings.push(error.message);
985:     }
986: 
987:     const previousHead = repository?.lastHead ?? null;
988:     let headRelation: 'same' | 'advanced' | 'diverged' | 'unknown' = 'unknown';
989:     if (previousHead && observation?.head && observation.root) {
990:       if (previousHead === observation.head) headRelation = 'same';
991:       else {
992:         const ancestor = await isAncestor(observation.root, previousHead, observation.head);
993:         headRelation = ancestor === true ? 'advanced' : ancestor === false ? 'diverged' : 'unknown';
994:       }
995:     }
996: 
997:     const report = buildStatus({
998:       project,
999:       repository,
1000:       observation,
1001:       tasks: project ? this.store.listTasks(project.id, { limit: 200 }) : [],
1002:       items: project ? this.store.loadMemoryItems(project.id) : [],
1003:       activity: project ? this.store.listActivity(project.id, 8) : [],
1004:       previousHead,
1005:       headRelation,
1006:       clock: this.clock,
1007:       knownProjects: this.store.listProjects().map((candidate) => candidate.slug),
1008:       warning: warnings,
1009:     });
1010: 
1011:     // `master_status` is advertised as read-only, so it deliberately does not
1012:     // touch `last_accessed_at`; only real work passes do that.

1329: function normalizeClaim(value: string | TestRunInput): VerificationClaim | null {
1330:   if (typeof value === 'string') {
1331:     const text = value.trim();
1332:     if (text.length === 0) return null;
1333:     // A bare string is a description of a run, not a structured result.
1334:     return { method: truncate(text, 200), command: null, result: 'unknown', evidence: [text] };
1335:   }
1336:   const method = (value.method ?? value.command ?? 'verification').trim() || 'verification';
1337:   const result = parseVerificationResult(value.result) ?? (value.evidence && value.evidence.length > 0 ? 'pass' : 'unknown');
1338:   return {
1339:     method: truncate(method, 200),
1340:     command: value.command?.trim() || null,
1341:     result,
1342:     evidence: dedupe(value.evidence),
1343:   };
1344: }
1345: 
1346: function normalizeClaims(
1347:   testsRun: readonly (string | TestRunInput)[],
1348:   verification: readonly VerificationInput[],
1349: ): VerificationClaim[] {
1350:   const claims: VerificationClaim[] = [];
1351:   for (const value of testsRun) {
1352:     const claim = normalizeClaim(value);
1353:     if (claim) claims.push(claim);

1355:   for (const value of verification) {
1356:     const claim = normalizeClaim(value);
1357:     if (claim) claims.push({ ...claim, method: value.method?.trim() || claim.method });
1358:   }
1359:   return claims;
1360: }

35: const MIN_TERM_LENGTH = 2;
36: 
37: /**
38:  * Split a string into raw words, breaking camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case,
39:  * kebab-case, dotted and slashed identifiers, plus digit boundaries
40:  * ("F30", "issue42" -> "issue", "42").
41:  */
42: export function splitWords(input: string): string[] {
43:   if (!input) return [];
44:   const out: string[] = [];
45:   for (const chunk of input.split(/[^A-Za-z0-9_]+/)) {
46:     if (!chunk) continue;
47:     for (const part of chunk.split('_')) {
48:       if (!part) continue;
49:       // Break camelCase / PascalCase / letter-digit boundaries.
50:       const pieces = part.match(/[A-Z]+(?![a-z])|[A-Z]?[a-z]+|[0-9]+|[A-Z]/g);
51:       if (pieces) out.push(...pieces);
52:     }
53:   }
54:   return out;
55: }
56: 
57: /**
58:  * Lowercase, singularise lightly and drop noise. Used as the canonical form for
59:  * both indexing-time and query-time term matching, so the two always agree.
60:  */
61: export function normalizeTerm(token: string): string {
62:   let t = token.toLowerCase();
63:   if (t.length > 3 && t.endsWith('ies')) t = `${t.slice(0, -3)}y`;
64:   else if (t.length > 3 && t.endsWith('ses')) t = t.slice(0, -2);
65:   else if (t.length > 3 && t.endsWith('s') && !t.endsWith('ss') && !t.endsWith('us')) t = t.slice(0, -1);
66:   return t;
67: }
68: 
69: /** Tokenise text into normalised, de-duplicated terms with occurrence counts. */
70: export function termCounts(input: string): Map<string, number> {
71:   const counts = new Map<string, number>();
72:   for (const word of splitWords(input)) {
73:     const term = normalizeTerm(word);
74:     if (term.length < MIN_TERM_LENGTH) continue;
75:     if (STOPWORDS.has(term)) continue;
76:     counts.set(term, (counts.get(term) ?? 0) + 1);
77:   }
78:   return counts;
79: }
80: 
81: /** Normalised unique terms, ordered by first appearance (stable for rendering). */
82: export function keywords(input: string): string[] {
83:   return [...termCounts(input).keys()];
84: }
85: 
86: /** True when a term looks like a code identifier rather than prose vocabulary. */
87: export function isIdentifierLike(raw: string): boolean {
88:   return (
89:     /[a-z][A-Z]/.test(raw) ||
90:     raw.includes('_') ||
91:     raw.includes('.') ||
92:     raw.includes('/') ||
93:     raw.includes('()') ||
94:     /^[A-Z]{2,}/.test(raw)
95:   );
96: }

98: /** Split a repository-relative path into meaningful, normalised tokens. */
99: export function pathTokens(path: string): string[] {
100:   const segments = path
101:     .replace(/\\/g, '/')
102:     .split('/')
103:     .flatMap((segment) => {
104:       const dot = segment.lastIndexOf('.');
105:       const base = dot > 0 ? segment.slice(0, dot) : segment;
106:       return splitWords(base);
107:     })
108:     .map(normalizeTerm)
109:     .filter((token) => token.length >= MIN_TERM_LENGTH && !STOPWORDS.has(token));
110:   return [...new Set(segments)];
111: }
112: 
113: /** Directory segments of a path, excluding the basename and generic noise. */
114: function pathSegments(path: string): string[] {
115:   return path
116:     .replace(/\\/g, '/')
117:     .split('/')
118:     .filter(Boolean)
119:     .slice(0, -1)
120:     .map((segment) => normalizeTerm(segment))
121:     .filter((segment) => segment.length >= MIN_TERM_LENGTH && !GENERIC_PATH_SEGMENTS.has(segment));
122: }

124: /** Normalise a path for comparison: forward slashes, no leading "./" or trailing "/". */
125: export function normalizePath(path: string): string {
126:   let p = path.replace(/\\/g, '/').trim();
127:   while (p.startsWith('./')) p = p.slice(2);
128:   if (p.length > 1 && p.endsWith('/')) p = p.replace(/\/+$/, '');
129:   return p;
130: }
131: 
132: function basename(path: string): string {
133:   const normalized = normalizePath(path);
134:   const idx = normalized.lastIndexOf('/');
135:   return idx === -1 ? normalized : normalized.slice(idx + 1);
136: }
137: 
138: /**
139:  * Path affinity in [0, 1].
140:  *
141:  * Used to score how strongly a memory record's files relate to the files a task
142:  * touches. Total ordering is: identical path > same basename > shared directory
143:  * segments > shared filename tokens.
144:  */
145: export function pathAffinity(a: string, b: string): number {
146:   if (!a || !b) return 0;
147:   const na = normalizePath(a);
148:   const nb = normalizePath(b);
149:   if (na === nb) return 1;
150: 
151:   // Suffix containment: "src/x/y.ts" vs "y.ts" or "x/y.ts".
152:   if (na.endsWith(`/${nb}`) || nb.endsWith(`/${na}`)) return 0.9;
153: 
154:   const baseA = basename(na);
155:   const baseB = basename(nb);
156:   let score = 0;
157:   if (baseA === baseB) score = 0.8;
158:   else {
159:     const tokensA = new Set(pathTokens(baseA));
160:     const tokensB = new Set(pathTokens(baseB));
161:     if (tokensA.size > 0 && tokensB.size > 0) {
162:       let shared = 0;
163:       for (const token of tokensA) if (tokensB.has(token)) shared += 1;
164:       score = Math.max(score, 0.5 * (shared / Math.max(tokensA.size, tokensB.size)));
165:     }
166:   }
167: 
168:   const dirsA = new Set(pathSegments(na));
169:   const dirsB = new Set(pathSegments(nb));
170:   if (dirsA.size > 0 && dirsB.size > 0) {
171:     let shared = 0;
172:     for (const dir of dirsA) if (dirsB.has(dir)) shared += 1;
173:     if (shared > 0) score = Math.max(score, Math.min(0.55, 0.3 + 0.15 * shared));
174:   }
175:   return Math.min(1, score);
176: }
177: 
178: /** Best affinity between one path and a list of reference paths. */
179: export function bestPathAffinity(path: string, references: readonly string[]): number {
180:   let best = 0;
181:   for (const ref of references) best = Math.max(best, pathAffinity(path, ref));
182:   return best;
183: }
184: 
185: /** Overlap of two token sets as a Jaccard-style ratio in [0, 1]. */
186: export function setOverlap<T>(a: ReadonlySet<T>, b: ReadonlySet<T>): number {
187:   if (a.size === 0 || b.size === 0) return 0;
188:   let shared = 0;
189:   for (const item of a) if (b.has(item)) shared += 1;
190:   return shared / (a.size + b.size - shared);
191: }
192: 
193: /**
194:  * Coverage-weighted overlap: how much of the *query* set is covered by the
195:  * candidate. Rewards records that mention many task terms without penalising
196:  * them for being verbose, which Jaccard does.
197:  */
198: export function queryCoverage(query: ReadonlySet<string>, candidate: ReadonlySet<string>): number {
199:   if (query.size === 0 || candidate.size === 0) return 0;
200:   let shared = 0;
201:   for (const term of query) if (candidate.has(term)) shared += 1;
202:   return shared / query.size;
203: }
204: 
205: /** Truncate text on a word boundary, appending an ellipsis when cut. */
206: export function truncate(text: string, maxLength: number): string {
207:   const clean = text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
208:   if (clean.length <= maxLength) return clean;
209:   const cut = clean.slice(0, Math.max(0, maxLength - 1));
210:   const space = cut.lastIndexOf(' ');
211:   return `${(space > maxLength * 0.6 ? cut.slice(0, space) : cut).trimEnd()}…`;
212: }
213: 
214: /** Cheap token estimate used for budgeting the rendered brief. */
215: export function approxTokens(text: string): number {
216:   return Math.ceil(text.length / 4);
217: }
218: 
219: /** Collapse whitespace and strip a trailing period, for list rendering. */
220: export function tidy(text: string | null | undefined): string {
221:   if (!text) return '';
222:   return text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().replace(/\.$/, '');
223: }
224: 
225: /** Format a compact bullet list, or an empty string when there is nothing to show. */
226: export function bullets(items: readonly string[]): string {
227:   return items.map((item) => `- ${item}`).join('\n');
228: }
229: 
230: /** Case-insensitive substring test that tolerates undefined haystacks. */
231: export function containsIgnoreCase(haystack: string | null | undefined, needle: string): boolean {
232:   if (!haystack || !needle) return false;
233:   return haystack.toLowerCase().includes(needle.toLowerCase());
234: }
235: 
236: /** Nearest match from a list of candidates for a free-text term, or undefined. */
237: export function closestMatch(term: string, candidates: readonly string[]): string | undefined {
238:   const needle = normalizeTerm(term);
239:   if (!needle) return undefined;
240:   let best: { value: string; score: number } | undefined;
241:   for (const candidate of candidates) {
242:     const tokens = keywords(candidate);
243:     if (tokens.length === 0) continue;
244:     let score = 0;
245:     for (const token of tokens) {
246:       if (token === needle) score += 1;
247:       else if (token.startsWith(needle) || needle.startsWith(token)) score += 0.5;
248:     }
249:     score /= Math.sqrt(tokens.length);
250:     if (score > 0 && (!best || score > best.score)) best = { value: candidate, score };
251:   }
252:   return best?.value;
253: }

201:         });
202:       }

204:       const created = store.createProject({ slug, name: input.project, now });
205:       const observation = await observeMaybe(startingPath, observeOptions);
206:       const { repository } = attachRepository({

208:         project: created,

215:       warnings.push(...config.warnings);

230:       clock,
231:       project,
232:       observation: await observeMaybe(startingPath, observeOptions),

236:       source: 'explicit',
237:       now,
238:       observeOptions,
239:     });

242:   // ---- 2. Known repository mapping by path --------------------------------

268:     const project = store.getProject(mappedByRoot.projectId);
269:     if (project) {
270:       return finish({
271:         store,
272:         clock,
273:         project,
274:         observation: await observeMaybe(repositoryPath, observeOptions),
275:         configWarnings: warnings,
276:         startingPath,
277:         allowCreate: input.allowCreate,
278:         source,
279:         now,
280:         observeOptions,
281:       });
282:     }
283:   }
284: 
285:   const observation = await observeMaybe(repositoryPath, observeOptions);
286:   const normalizedRemote = normalizeRemoteUrl(observation?.remoteUrl);
287:   if (normalizedRemote) {
288:     const remoteMatch = store
289:       .listRepositories()
290:       .find((repository) => normalizeRemoteUrl(repository.remoteUrl) === normalizedRemote);
291:     if (remoteMatch) {
292:       const project = store.getProject(remoteMatch.projectId);
293:       if (project) {
294:         const result = await finish({
295:           store,
296:           clock,
297:           project,
298:           observation,
299:           configWarnings: warnings,
300:           startingPath,
301:           allowCreate: input.allowCreate,
302:           source: 'remote',
303:           now,
304:           observeOptions,
305:         });

307:           // The same remote was checked out at a second path; register it.
308:           attachRepository({

311:             repositoryPath,
312:             observation,

393:  * Shared tail for the "project already known" branches: load config, ensure the

396: async function finish(input: {
397:   store: Store;
398:   clock: Clock;
399:   project: Project;
400:   observation: RepositoryObservation | null;
401:   configWarnings: string[];
402:   startingPath: string;
403:   allowCreate: boolean;
404:   source: DiscoverySource;
405:   now: string;
406:   observeOptions: ObserveOptions | undefined;
407: }): Promise<DiscoveryResult> {
408:   const warnings = [...input.configWarnings];
409:   const repositoryPath = input.observation?.root ?? input.startingPath;
410:   const existing = input.store.findRepositoryForPath(repositoryPath);
411:   let repository: Repository | null = existing ?? null;
412:   let createdRepository = false;
413: 
414:   if (input.allowCreate && (!existing || existing.projectId !== input.project.id)) {
415:     const attached = attachRepository({
416:       store: input.store,
417:       project: input.project,
418:       repositoryPath,
419:       observation: input.observation,
420:       now: input.now,
421:       warnings,
422:     });
423:     repository = attached.repository;
424:     createdRepository = attached.created;
425:   }
426: 
427:   const config = await loadConfigFor(input.startingPath, input.observation);
428:   warnings.push(...config.warnings);
429: 
430:   // Config may declare the project identity; fill in gaps that were never recorded.
431:   if (input.allowCreate) {
432:     const patch: { goal?: string; phase?: string; name?: string; now: string } = { now: input.now };
433:     if (!input.project.goal && config.goal) patch.goal = config.goal;
434:     if (!input.project.phase && config.phase) patch.phase = config.phase;
435:     if (config.name && input.project.name !== config.name && input.project.name === input.project.slug) {
436:       patch.name = config.name;
437:     }
438:     if (Object.keys(patch).length > 1) input.store.updateProject(input.project.id, patch);
439:   }
440: 
441:   return {
442:     project: input.store.getProject(input.project.id) ?? input.project,
443:     repository,
444:     repositoryPath,
445:     observation: input.observation,
446:     config,
447:     source: input.source,
448:     createdProject: false,
449:     createdRepository,
450:     warnings,
451:   };
452: }

7:  *
8:  * No embeddings, no network, no LLM. Signals used:

73: function normalizedSubsystem(value: string): string {
74:   return value.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '');

77: /** Exact, containment or token-level agreement between two subsystem labels. */
78: function subsystemMatch(a: string | null, b: readonly string[]): { score: number; matched: string | null } {
79:   if (!a) return { score: 0, matched: null };
80:   const left = normalizedSubsystem(a);
81:   if (left.length === 0) return { score: 0, matched: null };
82:   for (const candidate of b) {
83:     const right = normalizedSubsystem(candidate);
84:     if (right.length === 0) continue;
85:     if (left === right) return { score: WEIGHTS.subsystemExact, matched: candidate };
86:   }
87:   for (const candidate of b) {
88:     const right = normalizedSubsystem(candidate);
89:     if (right.length >= 4 && (left.includes(right) || right.includes(left))) {
90:       return { score: WEIGHTS.subsystemPartial, matched: candidate };
91:     }
92:   }
93:   return { score: 0, matched: null };
94: }

100:     case 'task':
101:       return item.status === 'blocked' || item.status === 'in_progress' || item.status === 'todo';
102:     case 'constraint':
103:       return item.status === 'active';
104:     case 'decision':
105:       return item.status === 'active';
106:     default:

114:   const priority = item.priority ? priorityWeight(item.priority) : 0;

119: function confidenceSignal(item: MemoryItem): number {

121:   return confidenceRank(item.confidence) / 4;

124: /** Score one memory item against the relevance context. */
125: export function scoreItem(item: MemoryItem, context: RelevanceContext): ScoredItem {
126:   const breakdown: Record<string, number> = {};
127:   const reasons: string[] = [];
128: 
129:   const subsystem = subsystemMatch(item.subsystem, context.subsystems);
130:   if (subsystem.score > 0) {
131:     breakdown['subsystem'] = subsystem.score;
132:     reasons.push(`subsystem: ${item.subsystem}`);
133:   }
134: 
135:   if (context.files.length > 0 && item.files.length > 0) {
136:     let best = 0;
137:     let bestFile = '';
138:     for (const file of item.files) {
139:       const affinity = bestPathAffinity(file, context.files);
140:       if (affinity > best) {
141:         best = affinity;
142:         bestFile = file;
143:       }
144:     }
145:     if (best > 0) {
146:       breakdown['files'] = WEIGHTS.files * best;
147:       reasons.push(best >= 0.8 ? `same file: ${bestFile}` : `related file: ${bestFile}`);
148:     }
149:   }
150: 
151:   const itemTerms = new Set(item.terms);
152:   const coverage = queryCoverage(context.terms, itemTerms);
153:   if (coverage > 0) {
154:     breakdown['terms'] = WEIGHTS.terms * coverage;
155:     if (coverage >= 0.5) reasons.push('matches task wording');
156:   }
157: 
158:   if (context.identifierTerms.size > 0) {
159:     let hits = 0;
160:     const examples: string[] = [];
161:     for (const identifier of context.identifierTerms) {
162:       if (itemTerms.has(normalizeTerm(identifier))) {
163:         hits += 1;
164:         if (examples.length < 2) examples.push(identifier);
165:       }
166:     }
167:     if (hits > 0) {
168:       breakdown['identifiers'] = Math.min(1, hits / context.identifierTerms.size) * WEIGHTS.identifiers;
169:       reasons.push(`mentions ${examples.join(', ')}`);
170:     }
171:   }
172: 
173:   const fullText = context.fullTextScores.get(item.id);
174:   if (fullText && fullText > 0) {
175:     breakdown['fullText'] = WEIGHTS.fullText * fullText;
176:   }
177: 
178:   const urgencyScore = urgency(item);
179:   if (urgencyScore > 0) {
180:     breakdown['severity'] = WEIGHTS.severity * urgencyScore;
181:     if (item.kind === 'bug' && item.severity && severityWeight(item.severity) >= severityWeight('high')) {
182:       reasons.push(`${item.severity}-severity bug`);
183:     }
184:     if (item.priority === 'P0' || item.priority === 'P1') reasons.push(`${item.priority} task`);
185:   }
186: 
187:   const recency = recencyScore(item.createdAt, context.clock, RECENCY_HALF_LIFE_DAYS);
188:   breakdown['recency'] = WEIGHTS.recency * recency;
189: 
190:   if (isUnresolved(item)) {
191:     breakdown['unresolved'] = WEIGHTS.unresolved;
192:   }
193: 
194:   if (context.taskId && item.taskId === context.taskId) {
195:     breakdown['relationship'] = WEIGHTS.relationship;
196:     reasons.push('recorded for this task');
197:   } else if (item.head && item.head.length > 0 && item.kind === 'handoff') {
198:     // A handoff recorded at a recent HEAD is closer to the current state.
199:     const matchedFile = context.recentlyChangedFiles.some((file) => item.body.includes(file));
200:     if (matchedFile) {
201:       breakdown['relationship'] = WEIGHTS.relationship * 0.5;
202:       reasons.push('touches files changed in recent commits');
203:     }
204:   }
205: 
206:   const confidence = confidenceSignal(item);
207:   if (confidence > 0) breakdown['confidence'] = WEIGHTS.confidence * confidence;
208: 
209:   const total = Math.min(1, Object.values(breakdown).reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0));
210:   return { item, score: Number(total.toFixed(4)), reasons, breakdown };
211: }

213: export interface ScoreOptions {
214:   /** Keep only items scoring at least this much. Defaults to RELEVANCE_THRESHOLD. */
215:   threshold?: number;
216:   /** Restrict to specific memory kinds. */
217:   kinds?: readonly MemoryItem['kind'][];
218: }
219: 
220: /**
221:  * Score and rank a candidate set.
222:  *
223:  * Ordering is fully deterministic: score descending, then a stable tie-break on
224:  * severity, then creation time descending, then id, so equal scores never
225:  * reorder between runs.
226:  */
227: export function rankItems(
228:   items: readonly MemoryItem[],
229:   context: RelevanceContext,
230:   options: ScoreOptions = {},
231: ): ScoredItem[] {
232:   const threshold = options.threshold ?? RELEVANCE_THRESHOLD;
233:   const allowed = options.kinds ? new Set(options.kinds) : null;
234:   return items
235:     .filter((item) => (allowed ? allowed.has(item.kind) : true))
236:     .map((item) => scoreItem(item, context))
237:     .filter((scored) => scored.score >= threshold)
238:     .sort((a, b) => {
239:       if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score;
240:       const severityDelta = (b.item.severity ? severityWeight(b.item.severity) : 0) - (a.item.severity ? severityWeight(a.item.severity) : 0);
241:       if (severityDelta !== 0) return severityDelta;
242:       if (a.item.createdAt !== b.item.createdAt) return b.item.createdAt.localeCompare(a.item.createdAt);
243:       return a.item.id.localeCompare(b.item.id);
244:     });
245: }

247: /** Compact one-line summary of why an item was selected. */
248: export function reasonSummary(scored: ScoredItem): string {
249:   return scored.reasons.slice(0, 3).join('; ');
250: }

252: /**
253:  * Render a bug as a compact, decision-ready line: what is wrong, and how it was
254:  * observed. Only fields actually recorded are shown.
255:  */
256: export function describeBug(bug: Bug): string {
257:   const parts: string[] = [];
258:   if (bug.observed) parts.push(`observed: ${truncate(bug.observed, 160)}`);
259:   else if (bug.expected) parts.push(`expected: ${truncate(bug.expected, 120)}`);
260:   if (bug.reproduction) parts.push(`repro: ${truncate(bug.reproduction, 140)}`);
261:   return parts.join(' | ');
262: }

274: /** Strongest severity present in a set, or null when empty. */
275: export function strongestSeverity(severities: readonly Severity[]): Severity | null {
276:   let best: Severity | null = null;

278:     if (!best || severityWeight(severity) > severityWeight(best)) best = severity;
